title: Rubén Darío: the poet who changed Spanish poetry
goal: Tell the life and work of Rubén Darío and put the important piece first, with fronting.
grammar: emphatic fronting: Decisiva fue…, En León murió… (review)

sections.title: Rubén Darío: the poet who changed Spanish poetry
body: In this lesson you read about Rubén Darío, the Nicaraguan poet. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for putting the important piece first: *Decisiva fue la influencia de Darío*.

items: I can put an adjective, a place or a time first to stress it, as in *Decisiva fue…*.
I can tell where and when Darío was born, published and died.
I can name three of his books.
